name: complysense
description: ComplySense root runner for React, FastAPI API, and FastAPI AI service

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend,ai -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.install:python: cd backend && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
